title: marketplace-onboarding-journey-maps-and-instrumentation-checklist
body:
Purpose

Quick working doc: map partner listing -> buyer trial -> entitlement -> telemetry -> post-launch remediation. Primary goal is an operational checklist + short copy variants we can A/B during catalog trial. This is a working sprint artifact (notes, questions, TODOs).

Audience
- GTM product managers, partner engineers, marketplace ops, legal/finance reviewers, solutions engineers.

Summary (TL;DR)
- Define a single, repeatable onboarding journey for partners publishing a Redwood Inference listing.
- Capture the minimum product & billing contracts to support a time-limited trial (30d eval + credit assignment).
- Instrument every customer-facing step with events so we can correlate listing traffic -> trial starts -> API usage -> conversion.
- Provide three copy variants (tile title + short blurb) to test click-through and trial starts.

High-level partner journey (map)
1) Intake: partner signs listing intake form -> marketplace account created -> entitlement SKU reserved (Ops action). Acceptance gate: intake form complete + security questionnaire answered.
2) Tile live (staging): catalog tile appears in staging feed for QA. Acceptance gate: tile assets uploaded (icon, hero, 1-line, 300 char copy), SSO optional config present, billing SKU linked.
3) Preview & smoke: internal QA + partner sees preview link. Run smoke-tests (sample request + output sanity). Acceptance gate: smoke test pass (sample prompts produce <=10% error rate) and latency within declared profile.
4) Trial provisioning: buyer clicks tile -> starts trial -> trial entitlement issued (time-limited SKU, sandbox API key) and trial onboarding email sent. Acceptance gate: entitlement issued + onboarding email logged + first successful API call within 24h (if not, trigger help flow).
5) Usage ramp & quality tracking: collect telemetry (events listed below). Acceptance gate: usage patterns measured, quality regressions flagged.
6) Conversion flow: buyer converts via tenant purchase or contact sales. Acceptance gate: billing confirmed + tenant mapping established.

Instrumentation & telemetry checklist (required events)
- event: listing-view (tile_id, user_region, referrer)
- event: tile-click (tile_id, variant_id, timestamp)
- event: trial-init (partner_id, buyer_id if available, entitlement_id, sku, trial_length_days, source)
- event: trial-email-sent (entitlement_id, email_template_id)
- event: trial-key-issued (entitlement_id, masked_key_id)
- event: first-api-success (entitlement_id, latency_ms, model_variant)
- event: trial-usage (entitlement_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, top_prompt_bucket)
- event: quality-assertion (entitlement_id, prompt_id, eval_score, pass_fail)
- event: conversion (entitlement_id -> paid_sku, invoice_id)
- event: support-escalation (entitlement_id, severity, channel)

Instrumentation notes
- Add context tags: market (aws-eu-west-1 / gcp-us-central1), listing_channel (marketplace|partner-site), model_profile (latency-tier|cost-tier).
- Correlate entitlement_id to tenant_id in post-provision mapping table.
- Ship a lightweight SDK snippet for partners to test sample prompts (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-ops/pull/58). Do not leak production keys in docs.

Trial entitlement / SKU mapping rules (ops-friendly)
- Create trial SKUs that map 1:1 to paid SKUs but with metadata: trial_duration_days, max_tokens_cap, allowed_models (subset). Example: paid_sku=redwood-hosted-embed-1 -> trial_sku=trial-redwood-hosted-embed-1-30d.
- Trials automatically expire and revoke sandbox keys; soft-notify 72h and 24h before expiry.
- If trial usage exceeds threshold (e.g., 50% of anticipated bill), flag AM to reach out and offer conversion discount.

Minimum acceptance checklist for publishing (pre-launch)
- Assets: 1x 1280x720 hero (png), 1x 128x128 icon, 1-line title (<=60 chars), short blurb (<=160 chars), long description (<=300 words), 2–3 screenshot images showing UI or example outputs.
- Security: partner filled security questionnaire + confirmed data handling approach (required for Private deployments).
- Billing: billing entity mapped, paid_sku and trial_sku linked, tax/legal reviewed for region.
- QA: smoke-tests (on-sheet) passed, latency and failure budgets measured.
- Legal: TOU snippet present + link to partner privacy policy.
- Support: onboarding playbook and triage runbook added to partner folder.

Copy variants (tile title + 1-line) - test suggestions
Variant A (clarity):
- Tile title: "Redwood Fast Inference API"
- 1-line: "Low-latency LLM inference with predictable pricing—30-day sandbox, no infra to manage."

Variant B (benefit-led):
- Tile title: "Scale LLM features with predictable latency"
- 1-line: "Dedicated inference runtime, smart batching, and 30 days free evaluation—integrate in minutes."

Variant C (developer hook):
- Tile title: "Plug-and-play LLM endpoints (dev-friendly)"
- 1-line: "SDKs, live tracing, and per-token cost breakdown—try with a 30d trial and sample prompts."

Long description (single canonical, editable)
- Use 2 short paragraphs + bullet list of capabilities. Start with the problem we solve (latency/cost unpredictability). Keep tone engineering-first; sprinkle measured claims (e.g., "<50ms p50 on gen-128 requests on Dedicated tiers") only if validated by bench.

Snippet experiment matrix (what to test in the first 2-week trial launch)
- Metric: trial-start-rate, first-api-success-rate, 7-day-retention, conversion-rate
- Test 1: CTA wording on tile (Variants A/B/C) -> measure tile-click -> trial-init
- Test 2: Onboarding email cadence (immediate vs 24h delayed) -> measure first-api-success within 72h
- Test 3: Trial cap threshold messaging (explicit quotas vs silent limits) -> measure escalations and conversions

Operational runbook (lightweight)
- Day 0 (launch): monitor listing-view -> tile-click -> trial-init pipeline for anomalies. Watch for large spikes in trial-init originating from a single IP (fraud).
- Day 1–3: check first-api-success ratio; if <60%, open priority ticket with partner SE and product.
- Day 7: evaluate retention and quality-assertions; if eval_score average < 0.7 on flagged prompts, schedule regression investigation.
- Day 14: run conversion cohort analysis and decide on next steps (extend trial, captive demo, or sales outreach).

Rollback and degrade strategies
- If smoke-tests fail post-publication: move tile to hidden_staging feed, notify partner, rollback to previous approved asset set.
- If telemetry indicates sudden cost spike: circuit-breaker automatically block new trial issuance for that partner; ops to review and clear.

Open questions / TODOs
- Do we want a self-serve trial or partner-mediated trial for Private listings? (Pros/cons documented but need final decision.)
- Which legal templates can be reused for APAC region (data residency + tax)? Assign to legal (Ravi).
- Confirm exact event property names with Eng telemetry (ENG-1724).
- Decide on default trial duration (30d vs 14d) based on historic conversion cohorts (GTM-89).

Notes to self / quick links
- Slack threads: #marketplace-onboarding, #partner-ops (see thread pinned messages).
- Confluence: Marketplace Onboarding Hub -> TODO checklist page (link above).
- GitHub: SDK snippet PR referenced in linked_artifacts.

Next steps (immediate)
- Sync with Marcus (ops) for automation of trial_sku creation (deadline: next sprint).
- Run A/B copy test for Variant A vs C for the next small release window.
- Legal to review APAC templates by EOD next week.

Appendix: sample onboarding email (first touch)
Subject: "Your Redwood Inference trial is ready — sandbox key inside"
Body: "Hi {first_name}, welcome! Your trial for {listing_title} is active for {n} days. Use this sandbox key to run up to {tokens_cap} tokens: {masked_key}. Quick start: 1) Try the sample prompt in the SDK; 2) Watch live traces in Console -> Traces; 3) Reply to this email to schedule a 30-min walkthrough. Resources: Quickstart, Pricing FAQ, Support."

-- end working draft --

(If you copy/paste, please preserve doc title and file name in the header so we can trace edits.)
